title: Train Your Own AI on a Laptop GPU for Less Than a PlayStation! 🧠💻 Meet Soup by Alpamys Makajan
description: Discover how Alpamys Makajan, a solo founder from Kazakhstan, has revolutionized AI training with his tool called Soup! Now, you can fine-tune your own large language model (LLM) on an affordable laptop GPU—less expensive than a PlayStation. Gone are the days of renting costly cloud GPUs and complex scripts. Soup simplifies the process to a single YAML config file and one command: just point it to your data, run Soup Train, and it handles the rest. The secret behind Soup’s efficiency is layer streaming. Instead of requiring 16 GB of VRAM to load an 8-billion-parameter model like Llama, Soup only needs 3.3 GB by loading, training, and swapping one layer at a time. Developers have achieved impressive speeds even on GPUs with just 4 GB of memory! Soup quickly went viral on Hacker News and is completely open-source. Want to give it a try?
